note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as PlayStation publishes it (Exophase and PSNProfiles agree on every name, description and grade). Guides are Sunset Ledger's own words. Every specific step cites its source; where no guide has confirmed a method yet, the trophy is flagged unconfirmed rather than guessed at.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum. Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks on its own. There is no shortcut: it is the sum of the whole roadmap — story, strangers, collectibles, activities and 100% completion.

steps.text: Follow the roadmap in order: story first, then strangers, then collectibles, then activities, then 100% cleanup.
steps.source: Sunset Ledger roadmap — built from the official descriptions

steps.text: Before anything else, do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation (Positive Mental Attitude) — it is the only trophy that can be missed.
Leave cheats off for the whole run: using a cheat disables trophies and saving for the session.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: The opening trophy. It pops when you finish Gone Fishing, Jason's first mission. Unmissable — it is the first step of the story.

steps.text: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to its end.
Story trophies unlock automatically and can't be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. Pure story progress — but finish the Chapter 1 missable business before the chapter ends (see Positive Mental Attitude).

steps.text: Play through Chapter 1 to its end.
Before the chapter ends: meditate on the balcony at Jason's house, do Shirley's two errands, and grab the magazines.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Pure story progress.

steps.text: Play through Chapter 2 to its end.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Pure story progress. When the Race Against Yago appears in this chapter, do it — it may count toward Strangers & Freaks.

steps.text: Play through Chapter 3 to its end.
Do Race Against Yago when it appears; one checklist warns that missing the race could cost you the Strangers & Freaks trophy.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. Pure story progress.

steps.text: Play through Chapter 4 to its end.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. The story's end — one of only two gold trophies. It pops when the last mission ends.

steps.text: Finish the final story mission.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. A story mission trophy — it pops when the mission ends.

steps.text: Play the mission Breakfast Run to its end.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist. A story mission trophy — it pops when the mission ends.

steps.text: Play the mission The Cartel Heist to its end.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete Child's Play. A story mission trophy — it pops when the mission ends.

steps.text: Play the mission Child's Play to its end.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete Headliners. A story mission trophy — it pops when the mission ends.

steps.text: Play the mission Headliners to its end.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown. A story mission trophy — it pops when the mission ends.

steps.text: Play the mission VCIA Takedown to its end.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory. A story mission trophy — it pops when the mission ends.

steps.text: Play the mission Operation Savage Glory to its end.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% Completion. The hardest trophy by most guides' reckoning — it is the whole 100% checklist, which opens after the story. Everything on it can be finished in free roam after the ending.

steps.text: Finish the story first; the 100% checklist opens after it.
Work the checklist in free roam: collectibles, activities, strangers and the rest — nothing on it is missable after the story.
Most trophies come naturally on the way to 100%, because the checklist asks for more than they do.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 Stunts. A pure count — stunts add up across normal play (jumps, near-misses, air time). It comes naturally on the way to 100%.

steps.text: Play normally and stunts accumulate; the 100% checklist asks for more than this trophy does.
If you are short at the end, chain jumps and air time in free roam.
steps.source: Sunset Ledger — own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. Just sample each one — no need to master any of them. Fishing, races, the shooting range, arcade games, bowling, meditation, hunting and drone races are all on the list.

steps.text: Try each type of activity once.
Sample them as they unlock during the story and side content — one try each is enough.
steps.source: Sunset Ledger — own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges. 42 challenges, and every one needs gold. This is a skill trophy — the range is the place to practise.

steps.text: Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges.
Practise at the range; gold medals are the only requirement — no other activity feeds this trophy.
steps.source: Sunset Ledger — own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. 14 locations — win one race at each.

steps.text: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations.
Races are per-location: one win each, not 14 wins at one place.
steps.source: Sunset Ledger — own reading of the official description

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Different races — 20 distinct events, not 20 wins of the same one.

steps.text: Win 20 different race events.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal and out-fish him in a challenge.

steps.text: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. One full arcade game, any machine.

steps.text: Finish one arcade game.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. A stranger/contact finale — work Andy's strand to its last mission.

steps.text: Play Andy's missions through to the final one.
Begin stranger chains as soon as they unlock; some have windows tied to story progress.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Work Kenton's strand to its last mission. Note: Kenton's shipwreck diving pauses after Chapter 1 but returns later — it is not missable.

steps.text: Play Kenton's missions through to the final one.
Kenton's shipwreck diving pauses after Chapter 1 and returns later — not missable.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Work Billy's strand to its last mission.

steps.text: Play Billy's missions through to the final one.
Begin stranger chains as soon as they unlock; some have windows tied to story progress.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Eight full stranger strands. Start each chain as soon as it unlocks — some have windows tied to story progress.

steps.text: Complete 8 stranger mission strands.
Begin each chain as soon as it unlocks; TechWiser reports windows tied to story progress.
Do Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 when it appears — it may count toward this trophy.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Work Randy's strand to its last mission.

steps.text: Play Randy's missions through to the final one.
Begin stranger chains as soon as they unlock; some have windows tied to story progress.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Work Tyrone's strand to its last mission.

steps.text: Play Tyrone's missions through to the final one.
Begin stranger chains as soon as they unlock; some have windows tied to story progress.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. 18 spots. THE missable one: one meditation is at Jason's house in Chapter 1 (Lucia's balcony meditation) and it goes away when the chapter ends. Do it early — guides disagree whether all 18 or only 15 are needed, so do all 18 to be safe.

steps.text: In Chapter 1, after Lucia mentions meditation in the kitchen at Jason's house, follow her to the balcony and accept the prompt.
Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 in total.
Guides disagree whether all 18 or 15 are needed; PowerPyx has not confirmed whether the Chapter 1 spot is required. Do it anyway — it is the only spot that can disappear.
Only one trophy is reported as possibly missable, and it is this one.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Find Bret's unique animal and hunt it.

steps.text: Hunt the unique animal for Bret.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Find and complete three full card sets.

steps.text: Complete 3 collectible card sets.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. 100 spots — a pure count, best done while exploring.

steps.text: WAiNK It at 100 locations.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. 50 challenges across the game's challenge list.

steps.text: Complete 50 challenges.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get to 4 stars with your partner, then lose the cops together.

steps.text: Reach a 4-star wanted level with your partner, then escape.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Three shops in a row, partner with you, and keep the wanted level the whole time.

steps.text: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. 100 distinct vehicles — discovering them counts as you drive and find them.

steps.text: Discover 100 vehicles across Leonida.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Five in one Combat Focus — set it up where enemies cluster.

steps.text: Down 5 enemies in a single Combat Focus.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Leave the airport in a way that isn't on the schedule — the description is deliberately vague, and this is Sunset Ledger's reading of it: an unplanned exit from VCIA, not a booked flight.

steps.text: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
Reading: an unplanned exit from the airport, not a scheduled flight.
steps.source: Sunset Ledger — own reading of the official description

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos.' The description is a joke, not an instruction. The working reading: take on Rhino tanks in combat.

steps.text: Take on Rhino tanks in combat.
steps.source: Sunset Ledger — own reading of the official description

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Stealth only — no alarms, no witnesses.

steps.text: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Five vaults, and get away clean each time.

steps.text: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape.

trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. One truck, one clean getaway.

steps.text: Rob an armored truck and escape.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. 52 areas — explore every one. It comes with normal travel and the 100% checklist.

steps.text: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. 9 gangs — one illegal operation from each.

steps.text: Rob one illegal operation of each of the 9 gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact trigger is still unknown — PowerPyx lists this trophy's condition as unknown. The description points at Ocean Beach; the working reading is a cocktail with an Ocean Beach view, but no guide has confirmed the exact spot or action yet.

steps.text: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
Exact trigger still unknown — PowerPyx lists the condition as unknown.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The exact trigger is still unknown — PowerPyx lists this trophy's condition as unknown. The description points at a vehicle showroom; no guide has confirmed the exact one or the exact smash yet.

steps.text: Smash out of a vehicle showroom.
Exact trigger still unknown — PowerPyx lists the condition as unknown.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. One guide reports the method: at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, take the luxury watch, the unique shotgun and the safe contents, then escape the police. That report comes from a single guide and is not yet confirmed by a second source.

steps.text: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Reported method (single source, not yet confirmed): at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, take the luxury watch, unique shotgun and safe contents, then escape the police.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: 'A partnership with mass appeal.' Two guides agree on the method: reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia.

steps.text: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia.
A second guide gives the same method.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: 'Choices made (for better or worse).' PSN tracks a count to 500: perform 500 actions affecting your Criminal Profile. It accumulates across the game — every choice that moves your profile counts.

steps.text: Perform 500 actions affecting your Criminal Profile.
A second guide gives the same count, and PSN tracks it to 500.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: 'Second time's the charm.' The exact trigger is still unknown — PowerPyx lists this trophy's condition as unknown. The description hints at succeeding on a second attempt, but no guide has confirmed what, exactly, has to be tried twice.

steps.text: The description hints at a second attempt.
Unlock condition not yet verified — PowerPyx lists it as unknown.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: 'What the hell just happened?' The exact trigger is still unknown — PowerPyx lists this trophy's condition as unknown. One guide reports a UFO abduction at night in Kelly County (near Starlet Motel, after helping a stranded woman), but that report is unverified by any second source, so treat it as a lead, not a fact.

steps.text: Exact trigger still unknown — PowerPyx lists the condition as unknown.
Unverified lead (single source): a UFO abduction during a nighttime encounter in Kelly County, near Starlet Motel.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: 'Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.' The exact trigger is still unknown — PowerPyx lists this trophy's condition as unknown. The description points at knocking targets down with a melee drive-by; no guide has confirmed the exact target or count yet.

steps.text: Knock targets down with a melee drive-by.
Exact trigger still unknown — PowerPyx lists the condition as unknown.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Launder a quarter of a million in marked bills — it accumulates as you run bills through contacts.

steps.text: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Total spending across every shop — it adds up over a normal playthrough.

steps.text: Spend $100,000 in shops.

trophies.name: Little Boxes

steps.text: Buy all 8 garage properties.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register ten vehicles in the app.

steps.text: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app.
